title: JBS Australia Celebrates Feedlot Industry at Second Annual Combined Feedlot Community Campdraft
summary: On Aug. 30, the JBS Australia Northern Livestock team hosted the second annual JBS Combined Feedlot Community Campdraft in Dalby, Queensland.
body_markdown:
On Aug. 30, the JBS Australia Northern Livestock team hosted the second annual JBS Combined Feedlot Community Campdraft in Dalby, Queensland.


The invitational event attracted more than 180 competitors from feedlots across the local area and beyond. Competitors swapped feedlot laneways and pens for the campdraft arena, showcasing their horsemanship while strengthening connections across the industry.


Bringing together feedlot teams, suppliers, industry partners and local supporters, JBS Feedlots Manager Scott Minnikin said the event was designed to recognize the people who contribute to the success of the grain fed beef supply chain.


"Our grain fed business is built on strong partnerships, from our suppliers and customers to the dedicated people working within our feedlots every day," Scott said.


"This event is an opportunity to bring everyone together, recognize their contribution, and celebrate the communities and relationships that make our industry so strong."


Beyond the competition, the campdraft provided an opportunity to give back to regional communities. Thanks to the generosity of sponsors and competitors, JBS proudly donated $5,000 to national mental health organization, Beyond Blue.


Following another successful year, JBS is already looking ahead to the future of the event, with plans to continue building on its success and further strengthening connections across the grain fed beef industry.
